headline: Made player, supporter, coaching, runtime, and startup claims evidence-backed across authority, freshness, and repeatability.

items.title: Evidence-backed player input and supporter trust
items.insight: Aim calibration now requires observed keyboard, pointer, touch, and gamepad input and expires after 30 days. Supporter status requires an exact backend callsign claim and its local verified cache expires after seven days.
items.evidence: src/utils/inputCalibration.js; src/utils/supporter.js; false-mint and expiry tests

items.title: Closed-loop coaching evidence
items.insight: Accepted drills now persist into live, replay, and rematch play. The game records observed outcomes and only surfaces repeatability after two improvements in the latest three deduplicated attempts, without claiming causality.

items.title: Truthful protocol and frame-loop sources
items.insight: Startup SIL history now has one multi-format parser, while the frame loop builds one reusable enemy index and compacts hot arrays in place. Both remove divergent or repeated sources of truth.

items.title: Read-only canonical closeout
items.insight: The autopilot now verifies doctor health through the project-local router in read-only JSON mode, preventing a closeout from mutating the sibling control-plane tree.
